description: This script manages translation workflows for documentation, including generating paths, invoking an AI agent for translation, and automating GitHub PR creation. It uses FastAPI's Typer CLI framework for commands related to translation, path management, and repository operations.

classes.name: typer.Typer
classes.description: Main CLI application class for command registration and execution.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: AI agent interface for running prompts and obtaining translations.

methods.name: get_langs
methods.description: Cached function to load language name mappings from YAML.

methods.name: generate_lang_path
methods.description: Generates the path for a translated language file based on source path.

methods.name: generate_en_path
methods.description: Generates the English source path from a translated language path.

methods.name: translate_page
methods.description: Translates an English documentation page into a specified language using an AI agent.

methods.name: iter_all_en_paths
methods.description: Iterates over all English documentation markdown files in priority order.

methods.name: iter_en_paths_to_translate
methods.description: Filters English paths that need translation based on non-translated sections.

methods.name: list_llm_translatable
methods.description: Lists languages that can be translated via LLM based on available prompt files.

methods.name: llm_translatable_json
methods.description: Outputs JSON list of translatable languages, optionally filtered by a specific language.

methods.name: commands_json
methods.description: Outputs JSON list of available CLI commands.

methods.name: list_removable
methods.description: Lists translated markdown files that can be removed if no English source exists.

methods.name: list_all_removable
methods.description: Lists all removable files across all languages.

methods.name: remove_removable
methods.description: Removes all files identified as removable for a given language.

methods.name: remove_all_removable
methods.description: Removes all removable files across all languages.

methods.name: list_missing
methods.description: Lists documentation pages missing translation in a specified language.

methods.name: list_outdated
methods.description: Lists translated files that are outdated compared to English source based on commit dates.

methods.name: update_outdated
methods.description: Updates all outdated translations for a language.

methods.name: add_missing
methods.description: Adds translations for missing documentation pages.

methods.name: update_and_add
methods.description: Performs both update of outdated and addition of missing translations.

methods.name: make_pr
methods.description: Creates a GitHub pull request with translation updates, optionally in a new branch.
